experiment_section: E Instructions (Reproduced From Li, 2017) — Game 3 / SP-RSD

instructions.description: Instructions for Game 3 (SP-RSD): explains 10-round structure, 4 prizes (A/B/C/D) worth $0.00–$1.25, priority score mechanism (random integer 1–10), prize assignment rules by priority order, tie-breaking, 90-second time limit, and example decision interface showing prizes with value inputs and Confirm Choices button
